name: Sky & Oath
inspiredBy: Zeus
text: Zeus watches over oaths, law and order. The Court gains 1 Favor every 4 turns.
flavor: Oaths sworn under the open sky are heard.

name: Counsel & the Defended City
inspiredBy: Athena
text: Athena defends towns. Olympian shrines start with +1 Ward.
flavor: The owl sits on the city wall and the wall holds.

name: Grain & Bread
inspiredBy: Demeter
text: Followers on grassland and plains give extra Faith.
flavor: Bread is the first gift and the last.

name: Sea & Shaking Earth
inspiredBy: Poseidon
text: Olympian priests may cross shallow sea; coastal settlements feel stronger Olympian pressure.
flavor: The shore belongs to whoever the sea allows.

name: Runes & Poetry
inspiredBy: Odin
text: Each word leads to another word. Winning followers from rivals earns Favor (1 per 10).
flavor: Each word led me on to another word.

name: Thunder & Shelter
inspiredBy: Thor
text: Eclipses cost 1 less Favor.
flavor: The hammer goes out and the hammer comes back.

name: Peace, Rain & Sunshine
inspiredBy: Freyr
text: Settlements you control grow by 1 extra every 4 turns.
flavor: Rain at the right time, sun at the right time.

name: The Woven Fate
inspiredBy: The Norns
text: The Norns set the fates of men. Your followers are 15% harder for rivals to convert.
flavor: What the Norns have scored in the wood stays scored.

name: The Sun's Course
inspiredBy: Re
text: Followers on desert and plains give extra Faith.
flavor: The sun sails, and the land is warm.

name: Order against Disorder
inspiredBy: Maat
text: Your followers are harder to convert (rivals need 35% more effort).
flavor: Maat in place of isfet.

name: Reckoning & Writing
inspiredBy: Thoth
text: Read Omens costs half and reveals 1 hex further.
flavor: The scribe counts what the god is owed.

name: The Inundation
inspiredBy: Osiris
text: Followers in settlements beside water give extra Faith.
flavor: The river rises, and the black land is fed.

name: The Word of Enlil
inspiredBy: Enlil, whose command could not be altered
flavor: What is decreed at Nippur is not argued with.
text: Every 5 turns gain 1 Favor for each 3 settlements you control (at most 2 per decree).

name: Waters of the Abzu
inspiredBy: Enki/Ea, lord of the fresh-water deep and of crafts
flavor: Canals are a craft, and Enki taught every craft.
text: Followers beside water give +0.15 Faith. Your pilgrim routes survive 2 extra turns of disruption.

name: The Morning and Evening Star
inspiredBy: Inana/Ištar as the planet Venus
flavor: She rises over one city at dusk and another at dawn.
text: Every 8 followers won from rivals earn 1 Favor (at most 4 Favor in the age).

name: The Seeing Sun
inspiredBy: Utu/Šamaš, who sees all on his daily path
flavor: Nothing done under the sun is unseen by the judge.
text: Read Omens reveals 1 hex further. Covenants you keep win +1 extra trust in the town.

name: The Undry Cauldron
inspiredBy: The Dagda and his cauldron
flavor: No company went away from it unsatisfied.
text: Every 5 turns up to 4 settlements you control grow by 1.

name: Brigit of the Forge and Well
inspiredBy: Brigit and her sisters of poetry, healing and smithcraft
flavor: What is broken at the forge is mended at the forge.
text: Eclipses on your shrines last 1 turn less. Every 4 turns a damaged shrine of yours regains 1 Ward.

name: Master of Every Art
inspiredBy: Lugh Samildánach at the gate of Tara
flavor: Is there one here who holds every art at once?
text: Ordaining a priest costs 3 less Faith, and you may retrain a priest at any shrine of yours for free once per turn.

name: The Prophecy of the Morrígan
inspiredBy: The Morrígan's prophecies at the close of Cath Maige Tuired
flavor: Peace to the sky, and after it a hard age.
text: You see coming weather within 4 hexes of your shrines. Counter-rites cost you 1 less Favor.

name: The Sweeping Wind
inspiredBy: Ehecatl-Quetzalcoatl, the wind that sweeps the road for rain
flavor: The wind goes first; the rain follows its broom.
text: Your priests see 1 hex further as they walk, and Seers walk 1 hex further.

name: The Rain Season
inspiredBy: Tlaloc, god of rain and the fertility of the fields
flavor: When the clouds come over the mountains the maize knows it.
text: Settlements you control under seasonal rains gain +1 prosperity a turn and +1 population when the rains end (at most 4 towns).

name: Movement of the Sun
inspiredBy: Tonatiuh, the sun of the present era (Nahui Ollin)
flavor: Four Movement: the sun of this age keeps its course.
text: During the Zenith (turns 16–30) gain 2 Favor every 5 turns.

name: She of the Jade Skirt
inspiredBy: Chalchiuhtlicue, goddess of lakes and running water
flavor: Greenstone is water made solid, and water is life.
text: Followers in settlements beside water give +0.18 Faith.

name: Shelter of the Storm God
inspiredBy: Tarḫunna, owner of the land
flavor: The land is his; the walls on it are his too.
text: Your shrines with Ward 2 or more lose 1 less Ward to eclipses and miracles (a hit still eclipses them).

name: Sun of Arinna
inspiredBy: The Sun goddess of Arinna, chief goddess of the state
flavor: The king holds the land for her, and she does not forget a gift.
text: Every 5 turns gain 1 Favor if one of your shrines has stood for at least 8 turns, +1 more if it is a Sanctuary.

name: The God Who Returns
inspiredBy: Telipinu, whose return restores growth
flavor: The bee found him asleep in a meadow, and the meadows woke with him.
text: Drought, storm and frost do half as much harm to your settlements, and they recover twice as fast afterwards.

name: Ḫepat's Guard
inspiredBy: Ḫepat, Hurrian queen of heaven at Yazılıkaya
flavor: She stands on her panther; she does not step down.
text: When one of your shrines is struck, your followers in that town are 50% harder to convert for 3 turns.

name: Sweet Water of Ọ̀ṣun
inspiredBy: Ọ̀ṣun and the river that runs through her grove
flavor: Where the river runs, the town drinks and grows.
text: Followers beside water give +0.12 Faith, and towns beside water that you control gain prosperity faster.

name: Ògún Opens the Road
inspiredBy: Ògún, òrìṣà of iron who opens roads
flavor: The cutlass clears the path; the path carries the people.
text: Consecrating a pilgrim route costs half, and each of your active routes gives +0.5 more Faith.

name: Hands that Shape
inspiredBy: Ọbàtálá, who shaped land and bodies
flavor: What was shaped once can be shaped again.
text: Every 3 turns each of your shrines with Ward below 3 regains 1 Ward, and the towns around it feel safer.

name: Thunder's Judgment
inspiredBy: Ṣàngó, òrìṣà of thunder and lightning
flavor: Thunder is heard by everyone; it answers only some.
text: Every 2 times your eclipses or miracles strike a rival shrine you gain 1 Favor (at most 4 in the age).

name: First Light
inspiredBy: Amaterasu, kami of the sun
flavor: The cave opens, and the world can see again.
text: During the Dawn (turns 1–15) Read Omens costs half and reveals 1 hex further.

name: After the Storm
inspiredBy: Susanoo, linked with wind and rain, who settled in Izumo
flavor: The serpent of the river was tamed and the fields were watered.
text: When a storm or an eclipse falls on one of your shrines it gains 1 Ward afterwards (once every 4 turns per shrine).

name: Making the Land
inspiredBy: Ōkuninushi, who consolidated the land
flavor: One country is many villages that agree on their borders.
text: Followers give +0.1 Faith in towns within 3 hexes of another town you control.

name: Rice of Inari
inspiredBy: Inari, tutelary kami of rice and the five grains
flavor: A full field is a prayer already answered.
text: Followers on grassland and plains give +0.15 Faith while their town's prosperity is 5 or more.

name: Breaker of the Dam
inspiredBy: Indra, who released the waters (RV 1.32)
flavor: He split the mountain, and the waters ran.
text: In towns under a storm your pressure on rival followers is 30% stronger.

name: The Kept Fire
inspiredBy: Agni, the perpetual household fire
flavor: The fire received from the father is passed to the son.
text: Each shrine of yours that has stood for 6 turns or more gives +1 Faith a turn.

name: Order and Oath
inspiredBy: Varuṇa, upholder of ṛta and of the oath
flavor: The oath is a rope; Varuṇa holds the other end.
text: Your followers are 15% harder to convert, 35% while you have broken no covenant this age.

name: Eye of the Gods
inspiredBy: Uṣas, the dawn who sees everything
flavor: She comes before the eyes, and the eyes open.
text: You start the age seeing 1 hex further, and your Dream Vision recovers 1 turn faster.
